title: nico's realism
description: A realism-focused texture mod that refreshes Minecraft’s visuals with more detailed, natural-looking textures, while keeping the classic vanilla style intact
body:
This mod is a visual-only realism texture upgrade for Minecraft

It does not change gameplay, mechanics, or balance. everything works exactly the same as vanilla. The goal is simply to make the world look more realistic, clean, and immersive without losing Minecraft’s iconic feel.

All textures are designed to blend seamlessly with the base game, making this mod perfect for:

Vanilla survival worlds

Realism-themed builds

Players who want better visuals without gameplay changes

# Features:

Enhanced realistic textures

No gameplay or mechanic changes

Vanilla-friendly art style

Works with existing worlds 

Lightweight and performance-friendly

Just install and play. no configs, no learning curve, just better visuals!
